newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil raises 406.7 mln reais with Sabesp shr sale.
newsitem.headline: Brazil raises 406.7 mln reais with Sabesp shr sale.

text.p: Brazil raised 406.7 million reais with Thursday's auction of 1.295 billion voting shares of Sao Paulo state sewage company Sabesp, the Sao Paulo Stock Exchange (Bovespa) said.
The shares were sold for 314 reais per lot of 1,000 shares, slightly above the minimum price of 313 reais, the bolsa said.
A total of 1.187 billion shares or 4.28 percent of Sabesp's voting capital belonged to Sao Paulo state government, while the remainder was offered by Sao Paulo city, it added.
Another four percent belonging to Sao Paulo state was offered to investors when Sabesp stock began trading on the Bovespa at an opening price of 278 reais early last month.
The exchange said local banks Garantia and Bozano, Simonsen acquired the biggest lots of shares at the auction.

Control of Sabesp is in the hands of the Sao Paulo state Finance secretariat; Companhia Paulista de Ativos (CPA), a holding covering the assets the state plans to privatize; and the state's water and energy department.
Sao Paulo state now holds 91 percent of Sabesp's capital, the exchange said.
Sabesp common stock was off 4.26 percent at 326 reais in midafternoon trade on the bolsa.
